svg.title: When the administrators hear of a failing mirror
svg.desc: After every run that is no dry-run, Paperless Sync counts the runs in a row that failed or completed with errors. A successful run ends the row and removes the notification. After the third run in a row, or once the first of them ended a day ago, every administrator gets one notification with the error of the last run and a link to the settings, once for the whole row. The setup checks under Administration, Overview and the status API show the same state at any time.
